changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'OrganizationResource') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationResource]( [OrganizationID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Accepted] [bit] NULL, [DateAccepted] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_OrganizationResource] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [OrganizationID] ASC, [ResourceID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_OrganizationResource_Organization') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationResource] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationResource_Organization] FOREIGN KEY([OrganizationID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Organization] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationResource] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationResource_Organization] END
